items.title: Apple confirms Apple Intelligence for China in December with iOS 27.3, Siri tapping Alibaba's Qwen
items.summary: Apple confirmed on Oct 31 that the first Apple Intelligence features open for testing Nov 4 in the latest iOS developer beta and ship publicly in December with iOS 27.3. Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence will tap Alibaba's Qwen — standing in where other countries can call ChatGPT — while the next-generation Siri AI from WWDC 2026 is excluded.

items.title: Alphabet sheds ~$500B in a day as AI search eats into Google's ad engine
items.summary: Alphabet fell about 13% on Oct 29, its market value dropping from $3.97T to $3.46T — its largest one-day wipeout ever. Search ad revenue grew 12% to $63.35B, below expectations, and Google executives acknowledged AI Mode generates fewer ads; Q3 free cash flow was -$9.1B as AI spending kept climbing.

items.title: Gemini's chat window becomes a file editor: docs, sheets and PDFs editable without leaving the conversation
items.summary: Google announced Oct 29 that the Gemini app can now generate, preview and edit documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDFs, Markdown and code inside the chat — edit full-screen, highlight text to ask questions, or have Gemini rewrite a section in plain language. PDFs work on web and mobile; other formats are web-only for now.

items.title: Cohere opens Series E targeting up to C$7B in a big sovereign-AI bet
items.summary: Toronto-based Cohere announced Oct 30 the initial close of a Series E targeting up to C$7B at a C$35.7B valuation, led by Germany's Schwarz Group with Nvidia and the Government of Canada participating; Ottawa separately committed up to C$1.6B in staged equity. Note: C$7B is the target ceiling, not cash already raised — the initial close amount was not disclosed.

items.title: ModelBest and OpenBMB open-source MiniCPM-OCR: 1.3B parser plus a 2B 'AI quality inspector'
items.summary: On Oct 31, ModelBest and OpenBMB open-sourced the MiniCPM-OCR series: the 1.3B MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 for high-accuracy document parsing on edge devices, and the 2B MiniCPM-OCR Jev — the first decision model for OCR results, acting as an 'AI quality inspector' that scores parsing output so pages need not be reviewed one by one. Weights, code and fine-tuning code are open, with vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp and Ollama support. (Despite the shared name, this Jev is unrelated to TypeSafe's decision model Jev.)

items.title: Xiaomi open-sources 0.8B document model Xiaomi-OCR-0: parsing, extraction and Q&A in one model
items.summary: Xiaomi open-sourced Xiaomi-OCR-0 on the night of Oct 30: just 0.8B parameters (built on Qwen3.5-0.8B), a single model that parses documents (Markdown, tables, LaTeX formulas), extracts key information as JSON, and answers questions about the document. Xiaomi says it ranks first among sub-1B models on OmniDocBench v1.6. Weights are Apache 2.0, with an MCP service and Agent Skill included, and it can run locally.

items.title: DeepSeek open-sources a new agent architecture that plugs straight into GitHub and Feishu
items.summary: DeepSeek open-sourced a new agent architecture on Oct 31 that integrates directly with developer platform GitHub and Chinese enterprise collaboration platform Feishu, aiming to let agents run multi-step tasks inside real workflows rather than only inside a chat. Public details are still thin; its real-world deployments are the thing to watch.
items.source: KIMKJ 中国 AI 简报

items.title: Lab-robot maker Opentrons raises $40M to be the 'execution layer' for AI-driven science
items.summary: New York lab robotics company Opentrons closed a $40M Series E led by Avego, with SoftBank Vision Fund and Khosla Ventures returning, aiming to turn its 11,000+ robots across 80+ countries into the place where AI-designed experiments actually run: the model proposes, the robot executes, and results feed back into the model.
